title: Gen 6 – Formula Pro Tubeless RBCC
notes: Official US page read 2026-11-01 (2025 Road): the fastest tubeless tire in IRC history; IRC claims 9.97% lower rolling resistance and 82% better wear than the previous model; dual compound with RBCC2; pure tubeless (sealant-free). Table (IRC no. 190701-190708, two colourways): 700x25C 270 g, 65-110 psi hooked / 65-73 psi hookless; 28C 310 g, 65-94 / 65-73; 30C 335 g, 60-80 / 60-73; 32C 360 g, 50-73 / 50-73; folding bead.
